questions.query: 星河计划发票需要多少天内提交
variants: 差旅结束后提交发票时间
expected: 星河计划差旅报销办法
questions.groundTruth: 员工应在行程结束后 30 个自然日内提交发票。

questions.query: 单笔超过3000元由谁审批
expected: 星河计划差旅报销办法
questions.groundTruth: 单笔费用超过 3000 元时，除直属主管外还需要财务总监审批。

questions.query: 青岚年假提前几个工作日申请
questions.groundTruth: 年假应至少提前 3 个工作日申请。

questions.query: 紧急病假何时补交证明
questions.groundTruth: 紧急病假可以在返岗后 24 小时内补交证明。

questions.query: 松果采购什么时候需要两家供应商报价
questions.groundTruth: 达到或超过 5000 元必须取得两家供应商报价。

questions.query: 采购申请编号前缀 SG-PO 属于什么规范
questions.groundTruth: 采购申请使用编号前缀 SG-PO。

questions.query: 赤霄账号泄露后多久轮换访问密钥
variants: 账号安全访问密钥轮换
questions.groundTruth: 发现账号疑似泄露后必须在 12 小时内轮换访问密钥，并撤销所有活动会话。

questions.query: 管理员账号允许只用短信验证吗
questions.groundTruth: 管理员账号必须使用硬件安全密钥，禁止短信作为唯一验证方式。

questions.query: 白鹭新员工几天内完成设备和安全培训
variants: 设备门禁安全培训七天
questions.groundTruth: 新员工应在入职后 7 天内完成设备领取、门禁登记和安全培训。

questions.query: 云杉普通客户服务记录保留多久
expected: 云杉客户资料保留政策
questions.groundTruth: 普通客户服务记录保留 18 个月，合同和付款凭证保留 7 年。

questions.query: 合同和付款凭证保留几年
expected: 云杉客户资料保留政策
questions.groundTruth: 普通客户服务记录保留 18 个月，合同和付款凭证保留 7 年。

questions.query: 天衡P1事故多久建立指挥频道
questions.groundTruth: P1 生产事故必须在 15 分钟内建立指挥频道，并在 30 分钟内通知值班负责人。

questions.query: 初步事故报告在恢复后多久完成
variants: 恢复服务后两小时报告
questions.groundTruth: 初步事故报告应在恢复服务后 2 小时内完成。

questions.query: 玄武数据库每天几点全量备份
variants: 主数据库全量备份时间
questions.groundTruth: 主数据库每天 03:20 UTC 执行全量备份，备份保留 35 天。

questions.query: 玄武备份保留多少天
questions.groundTruth: 主数据库每天 03:20 UTC 执行全量备份，备份保留 35 天。

questions.query: 飞廉灰度先发布多少实例并观察多久
questions.groundTruth: 新版本先向 10% 实例发布并观察 30 分钟。

questions.query: 飞廉发布错误率多高必须回滚
questions.groundTruth: 错误率高于 1.5% 或延迟增加超过 20% 时必须自动回滚。

questions.query: 翠竹跨服务请求使用什么追踪请求头
questions.groundTruth: 所有跨服务请求必须携带 X-Cedar-Trace 请求头。

questions.query: 黄鹂GPU温度达到多少停止新任务
variants: 推理服务器温度停任务
questions.groundTruth: 项目黄鹂的 GPU 温度告警线为 83 摄氏度，达到 88 摄氏度时立即停止新任务。

questions.query: 银沙标准工单首次响应时间
variants: 银沙队列四个工作小时
questions.groundTruth: 银沙队列的标准工单首次响应时间为 4 个工作小时。

questions.query: How long after travel can Orion receipts be submitted
questions.groundTruth: Employees must submit receipts within 21 calendar days after travel.

questions.query: Who approves an Orion expense above 750 dollars
questions.groundTruth: Any single expense above USD 750 requires approval from the finance controller.

questions.query: How far ahead must Harbor annual leave be filed
questions.groundTruth: Annual leave requests must be filed four business days in advance.

questions.query: When does Juniper require three vendor quotations
questions.groundTruth: Purchases at or above USD 1,200 require three vendor quotations.

questions.query: Which policy uses the JN-PO prefix
questions.groundTruth: Procurement requests use the prefix JN-PO.

questions.query: How quickly must Kestrel access keys be rotated after exposure
questions.groundTruth: Suspected credential exposure requires access-key rotation within eight hours and revocation of every active session.

questions.query: Can Kestrel administrators use SMS alone
questions.groundTruth: Administrator accounts must use hardware security keys; SMS alone is not accepted.

questions.query: When must Lighthouse employees complete security training
questions.groundTruth: New employees complete equipment pickup, badge enrollment, and security training within ten days.

questions.query: How long are Maple support records retained
questions.groundTruth: Ordinary support records are retained for 24 months.

questions.query: How many years does Maple retain contracts
questions.groundTruth: Contracts and payment evidence are retained for six years.

questions.query: How soon does Nimbus open a severity-one command channel
questions.groundTruth: A severity-one production incident requires a command channel within ten minutes and an on-call lead notification within twenty minutes.

questions.query: When is the Nimbus preliminary incident report due
questions.groundTruth: The preliminary report is due three hours after recovery.

questions.query: What time does the Otter full backup run
questions.groundTruth: The primary database receives a full backup every day at 02:40 UTC.

questions.query: How many days are Otter backups retained
questions.groundTruth: Backups are retained for 42 days.

questions.query: What percentage receives the Peregrine canary and for how long
questions.groundTruth: A new build first reaches 12 percent of instances and is observed for 25 minutes.

questions.query: At what Peregrine error rate is rollback mandatory
questions.groundTruth: Rollback is mandatory when error rate exceeds 2 percent or latency rises more than 15 percent.

questions.query: Which tracing header does Quartz require
questions.groundTruth: Every cross-service request carries the X-Quartz-Trace header.

questions.query: How long is a Quartz trace identifier
questions.groundTruth: The edge service creates a 24-character lowercase hexadecimal identifier, and downstream services preserve it unchanged.

questions.query: At what temperature does Raven stop accepting new jobs
questions.groundTruth: Project Raven raises a GPU temperature warning at 81 degrees Celsius and stops accepting new jobs at 87 degrees.

questions.query: What is the Silverline standard first-response target
questions.groundTruth: The standard Silverline queue has a first-response target of six business hours.
